Here we use three-dimensional fluorescence microscopy to visualize individual peptide–I-Ek class II MHC complexes labelled with the phycobiliprotein phycoerythrin in an effort to characterize T-cell sensitivity and the requirements for forming an immunological synapse in single cells.
